Inside the AI scientist environment

You describe the device; AI scientists design, train, compile and check, then hand back the smallest chip that does the job.

  1. Describethe device and what it must catch
  2. ProposeAI scientists sketch chip designs
  3. Trainthousands of small models at once
  4. Compilethe best model becomes logic gates
  5. Checkthe circuit against the model, bit for bit
